object: Wall label: column of inscription before figure B in the sculptured Meroitic Chamber
site: Philae, Great Temple of Isis, Meroitic Chamber
notes: Published L., D., VI, Bl. 4, no. 12. Griffith translates 'The honourable(?) akrêrê, second(?) Bekemete, begotten of the strategus of the water, second(?) (priest of?) Amani, pesatê, strategus of the azab; ....' His note (p. 39): after nobow (nêbêw, 'gold (?)') there seem to be numerals (cf. 101/8), and the last word is kelbo or klebo, its o made vertical between the outlines of the staff; the type runs × and an n-shaped sign on to kelbo with no space, written here {×}{numeral like n} (dropped from text_corpus); FHN III no. 267 reads '35 kelbo'. His '?' stands over the b and l of kelbo. The type has m in mte where FHN reads ste. 'a (5)tolit' and 'mni(10)se' are spaced as printed (FHN atolit, Mnise). Same signs as the 2026-11-09 test, except that × n is taken as numerals following Griffith.
